5 cups (~1.2 L) beef stock; typical low-fat broth values scaled to full quantity
2 medium onions (~220 g total raw); standard onion nutrition applied to edible portion

1 small tomato (~80 g raw); standard tomato nutrition

0.5 tsp ground cardamom; typical spice nutrition scaled to small quantity
0.5 tsp ground cloves; typical spice nutrition scaled to small quantity
0.5 tsp crushed bay leaf; typical spice nutrition scaled to small quantity
